origin: T33 hand-off (Ian team research, 2026-10-24); re-verified by T38

source.title: Clinical characterization and developmental follow-up of a child with Sotos syndrome carrying a novel NSD1 variant.

confirmation.summary: De novo nonsense NSD1 c.3910C>T on whole-exome sequencing, absent in both parents.
evidence: Whole-exome sequencing(WES) revealed a novel de novo nonsense pathogenic variant in NSD1:c.3910 C > T

note.text: My little boy is 17 months old and still hasn't said any words. He cannot crawl yet and can stand only if someone helps him. His head and body seem much bigger than those of children his age. His forehead is broad and his upper eyelids droop a little. He has trouble staying steady when he stands, and his feet seem to turn outward.
note.author: T33 hand-off (assistant-written from the article; not the parent's words)
